Name: Logo's Rug Emporium Extravaganza
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[size=6][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/WzRqR7K4/Title-Banner.png[/img][/b][/size]
[color=#000000][size=4][b]Img text: Logo's Rug Emporium Extravaganza[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=sans-serif]The Emporium has expanded! Welcome to Logo's Rug Emporium Extravaganza, a smorgasbord of designs and colors.[/font][/size][/color]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6p7KRNqg/Mod-Details-Banner3.png[/img]
[b][color=#000000]Img text: Logo's Rug Emporium Extravaganza[/color][/b]

[size=4][font=sans-serif]Introducing, for the first time, all of my previous rug mods compiled together into one collection for Content Patcher, along with 18 new rug designs in multiple sizes and rotation options, for a grand total of [i][u]180 individual rugs[/u][/i]. This mod includes the original designs from:[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]Geometric Rugs for AT[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]More Geometric Rugs for AT[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]Even More Geometric Rugs for AT[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=sans-serif]I have expanded on those designs - each now has multiple sizes and rotation options.[/font][/size]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0qgR0xG/Installation-Banner.png[/img]
[color=#000000][size=4][b]Img text: Installation[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=sans-serif]To install:[/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]Download mod and its required dependencies. If you want access to the new catalogue, you will need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6976914]sophiesalacia[/url].[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]Place downloaded mod(s) into your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=sans-serif]Launch game and enjoy![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=sans-serif]The Rug Emporium Catalogue can be purchased at Robin's Carpenter Shop for 10000g (configurable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url]). Individual rugs are not sold at any location. While not required, I strongly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url].[/font][/size]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9FkMsbqn/Credits-Banner3.png[/img]
[color=#000000][size=4][b]Img text: Credits & Thanks[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=sans-serif]Many thanks to my friends in the Stardew Valley Modding Community on Discord, who have been supportive and inspirational. Special thanks to Tenebrous Nova for always hyping up my work and to Wizadroid for helping to come up with the different rug names. [/font][/size]
